In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LHC is not able to discriminate between the SM and the composite Higgs scenario, and that it is only able to set a lower bound of 200-250 GeV on the mass of the composite Higgs boson.
, while the LHC can distinguish between the SM and the composite Higgs scenario at 95% C.L. in the lνlν + two jet channel, the l+l− + 4 jet and 3l + 2 jet channels will not be able to do so.

the LHC is not able to distinguish between the Standard Model and the composite Higgs scenario at the 1σ level in the l+l− + 4 jets channel, and that the LHC has a 10% chance of detecting the composite Higgs signal at 5σ in the 3lν+ 2 jets channel, assuming the composite Higgs mass is below 1 TeV.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in the light Higgs scenario and for the benchmark model considered, the Higgsless signal is distinguishable from the Standard Model light-Higgs signal at the 3σ level in the lνlνlν + two-jets channel and at the 5σ level in the 3lνlνl + two-jets and the l+l−lνlν channels.

the LHC will be able to detect a composite Higgs in the Higgs mass range of 100–140 GeV at 5σ level in the VV scattering channels, if the Higgs mass lies in the range 100–140GeV, if a luminosity of 3000 fb−1 has been accumulated and if the Higgs couplings to vector bosons are close to the Standard Model predictions.
the LHC is able to distinguish the SM light Higg scenario from a composite Higgs model with a Higgs mass below 300 GeV, but it cannot discriminate between the latter and the Higgs massless case.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a signal for composite Higgs can be seen at the LHC for the Higgs masses considered here, but only for a very small region of the parameter space.
the LHC can distinguish between the SM and the composite Higgs case, but it cannot distinguish between the composite Higgs and strong scattering scenarios.
, for the LHC running with 14TeV centre of mass energy, a composite Higgless signal will be difficult to distinguish from the SM light Higgless one.
